description: This Java class defines BOMNode, representing a component in a bill of materials within a manufacturing context. It includes methods for loading children and parent nodes, substitution logic, manufacturing order creation, and various utility functions related to BOM structure and product management.

classes.name: BOMNode
classes.description: Represents a node in a bill of materials, with methods for managing BOM structure, substitutions, manufacturing orders, and product relations within a manufacturing process.

methods.name: loadChildren
methods.description: Loads child nodes based on product associations, with optional substitution and filtering based on BOM type and date.

methods.name: loadParents
methods.description: Loads parent nodes based on product associations, considering substitution if applicable.

methods.name: getParentNode
methods.description: Returns the parent BOMNode.

methods.name: getRootNode
methods.description: Returns the root node of the BOM tree.

methods.name: setParentNode
methods.description: Sets the parent BOMNode.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Recursively prints the BOM structure for debugging or display.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Collects products that are in shipment packages, considering BOM structure.

methods.name: sumQuantity
methods.description: Aggregates quantities across BOM nodes into a map keyed by product ID.

methods.name: createManufacturingOrder
methods.description: Creates manufacturing orders and related production runs for this BOM node and its children.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Calculates the earliest start date for manufacturing based on BOM structure and proposed orders.

methods.name: isWarehouseManaged
methods.description: Determines if the product is managed in a warehouse, based on product type and related facilities.

methods.name: isManufactured
methods.description: Checks if the product is considered manufactured, considering supplier products and children nodes.

methods.name: isVirtual
methods.description: Returns true if the product is virtual.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the BOM node is configured, adding virtual nodes to the list.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of this node.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of this node.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of this node in the BOM tree.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the product associated with this node.

methods.name: getSubstitutedNode
methods.description: Returns the substituted node, if any.

methods.name: setSubstitutedNode
methods.description: Sets the substituted node.

methods.name: getRootProductForRules
methods.description: Returns the root product for rule application.

methods.name: getProductForRules
methods.description: Returns the product for rule processing.

methods.name: setProductForRules
methods.description: Sets the product for rule processing.

methods.name: getBomTypeId
methods.description: Returns the BOM type ID.

methods.name: getQuantityMultiplier
methods.description: Returns the quantity multiplier.

methods.name: setQuantityMultiplier
methods.description: Sets the quantity multiplier.

methods.name: getRuleApplied
methods.description: Returns the rule applied to this node.

methods.name: setRuleApplied
methods.description: Sets the rule applied to this node.

methods.name: getScrapFactor
methods.description: Returns the scrap factor.

methods.name: setScrapFactor
methods.description: Sets the scrap factor.

methods.name: getChildrenNodes
methods.description: Returns the list of child BOMNodes.

methods.name: setChildrenNodes
methods.description: Sets the list of child BOMNodes.

methods.name: getProductAssoc
methods.description: Returns the product association value.

methods.name: setProductAssoc
methods.description: Sets the product association value.

methods.name: setTree
methods.description: Associates this node with a BOMTree.

methods.name: getTree
methods.description: Returns the BOMTree this node belongs to.
